annotations.text:
Read left to right, top to bottom. That is the order a new user meets the application: point it at a repo, confirm the map it found, then live in the hub.

Every screen is live. Click nodes, answer the drill, contest the grade, switch languages in the lesson, walk the survey stages.

Both panes are the same material at different densities. The sidebar is thin so the lit ground reads through it; the content pane is dense so nothing competes with text.

The ground drifts on a 54 second cycle and stops under reduced motion. That is the motion, kept in the shell.

THE CATALOGUE

Fifteen finished components across explain, ask and show. The agent picks one and supplies content; the application owns the layout, the states, the keyboard and the grading.

Click through the left rail. Four of them are live here: order the steps, pick the misconception, fill the blank, and exact recall.

The right column is what the agent actually writes. Never markup.

Three rules the screens exist to hold.

Nothing is revealed before you commit, the grounding file included.

Every estimate is drawn with its uncertainty. The pale band is the doubt, and on a thin topic it is wider than the bar.

A part the survey could not verify is drawn dashed and marked, never dropped.
